rationale: Focused review of the approved AI2 UI completion surface found no Critical or Important correctness, auth, XSS, contract, or data-leak issue. The existing dirty worktree contains unrelated files; review was bounded to the task-owned frontend API/pages/tests, smoke script and release artifacts. Architecture ownership remains aligned with docs/system-architecture.md: Backend owns public APIs and AI2 remains evidence-first; relation-graph/risk contracts without an exposed Backend DTO remain explicitly unclaimed. Security mechanical scan stopped on its own harness secret-pattern regex (basic-auth-url), not on a task-owned credential. Credential-dependent authenticated E2E remains SKIP in release verification, not a code-review defect.
